title: Zesty Velvety Ukrainian Chicken Skillet
description: A tangy and velvety Ukrainian dish featuring fresh thyme, slow-cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet, this recipe is a show-off dish that is low in calories and rich in flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the chicken broth, dried dill weed, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped fresh thyme and sour cream.
Continue to simmer the mixture for an additional 5 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot over rice or noodles.
